title: Gold Expansion
description: A mod that expands on gold,making it more useful.
body: The Gold Expansion mod focuses on expanding and making gold more useful by adding a lot of new features to gold,things like reinforced golden tools and armor,decoration blocks,foods,advancements,commands,paintings and more! The mod aims to be fair,so gold doesn't become the best ore in the game in terms of tools and armor,as that wouldn't be very interesting,anyone can do that.
